title: dungdra/combat.py move(): the Prone checks hard-code the mode names (`mode not in ("walk", "crawl")`, `mode == "walk"`). Have them use the MOVE_MODES spec (spec.speed == "walk") so the list of modes allowed while Prone comes from that table.

history.summary: combat.move() now finds the mode's MOVE_MODES entry before the Prone checks. While Prone, only modes whose spec.speed == "walk" are allowed; anything else is refused with page 186 and rule GLOSS.prone#1. A mode not in the table is also refused while Prone, as before. The double cost for crawling now uses spec.speed == "walk" instead of mode == "walk". Two unit tests were added: a Prone creature that walks pays double, and a Prone creature is refused a mode that isn't in the table. Unit tests: 362 passed. SRD and scenario tests: 329 passed, 33 xfailed. ruff check, ruff format --check and dev-gate all pass.
